download_models_default: download all default docling models to the cache directory
download_models_custom_dir: download docling models to a custom output directory with force overwrite
download_models_selective: download only layout and tableformer models skipping code formula and picture classifier
download_models_vlm: download smolvlm, smoldocling, and granite vision VLM models for picture description
download_models_easyocr: download easyocr models for optical character recognition
